name: Qwen 3.8
summary: Qwen3.8 is Alibaba's Qwen model family, released in August 2026. It mixes open-weight models, such as the dense 27B and the 2.4T-parameter mixture-of-experts model, with hosted variants like Qwen3.8 Max, which adds vision input and built-in tools on top of the open 2.4T weights.
facts: Qwen3.8 Max, Qwen3.8 Flash, Omni Flash
262K native; about 1M with YaRN or on Max
Hybrid Gated DeltaNet and Gated Attention
goodFor: Self-hosted agents on a single node (27B)
Choice of sizes from small to frontier
watchOut: 2.4T weights use a custom qwen3.8-max license
2.4T open model is text-only, thinking always on
Hosted Max features are not all in the open weights
